caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with a rich, reddish-brown color, showcasing a visible wood grain pattern across its surfaces. The table features a drop-leaf design on the left side, where one panel hangs vertically, supported by two turned legs underneath. The right side of the table shows the main body with an additional turned leg at the front and simple rectangular structure along the top and sides. The rest of the legs are visible beneath the main structure of the table, all designed in a rounded, turned style. The background is a plain, light beige color, and there are soft, diffuse shadows cast by the table legs onto the surface below. The artist's signature, "Frank K. Weiser," appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Drop Leaf Table
